disclaimer.lead: Health Trail is a notebook. It helps you keep track of someone's care: the calls, the visits, the questions, and the paperwork that piles up around all of it.
disclaimer.block.1.title: It is not a medical app
disclaimer.block.1.body: It gives no medical advice, and it is not a medical device. Nothing here replaces a doctor, a nurse, emergency services, or advice from a lawyer. If something is urgent, call emergency services.
disclaimer.block.2.title: What you write stays on this phone
disclaimer.block.2.body: There is no account and no cloud. Your notes live on this device and go nowhere else unless you send them somewhere yourself.
disclaimer.block.3.title: The record is yours
disclaimer.block.3.body: The app writes down what you tell it and keeps it organized. It never decides what any of it means. You choose what goes in, and it stays yours.
capture.sub: Answer what you can. Skip the rest. A half note beats no note.
capture.unfiled.note: Not sure yet goes to the Unfiled tray. The app suggests a home by matching words, and you confirm with one tap. It never files anything without you.
